projectName: Smart Induction Coffee Heater - Clean BDD + Traceability

properties.name: Interfaces
properties.defaultValue: GPIO, UART, I2C, ADC, Timer/PWM, Watchdog

properties.name: Filter
properties.defaultValue: Invalid rejection + median + moving average + hysteresis

properties.name: States
properties.defaultValue: OFF, IDLE, HEATING, POWER_LIMIT, AUTO_STOP, FAULT, COOLDOWN

blocks.name: Housing Material
blocks.description: Bottom enclosure shall use flame-retardant electrically insulating engineering plastic.

blocks.name: Housing Moisture Resistance
blocks.description: Housing shall tolerate humidity and splash exposure.

blocks.name: Top Panel Material
blocks.description: Top shall use heat-resistant induction-grade glass-ceramic.

blocks.name: Top Panel Dimensions
blocks.description: Top surface design dimensions shall be 170 x 170 x 4 mm.

blocks.name: Top Panel Temperature
blocks.description: Top surface design target shall be at least 250 degC continuous.

blocks.name: Pot Retention
blocks.description: Pot movement shall be limited by a low-profile retention rib.

blocks.name: IR Arm Lock
blocks.description: IR extension arm shall use a positive anti-rotation lock.

blocks.name: IR Arm Wiring
blocks.description: IR arm shall route only low-voltage wiring.

blocks.name: IR Window Environment
blocks.description: IR sensor housing/window shall resist steam and condensation and remain IR transmissive.

blocks.name: Cooling Openings
blocks.description: Housing shall provide cooling inlet and outlet while limiting spill ingress.

blocks.name: Pot Compatibility
blocks.description: Pot shall have an induction-compatible ferromagnetic base.

blocks.name: Pot Interior
blocks.description: Black beverage-contact interior shall use food-contact hot-liquid-rated material.

blocks.name: Touch Controls
blocks.description: User interface shall provide Power, Increase and Decrease touch zones with wet-touch mitigation.

blocks.name: Bottom Envelope
blocks.description: Bottom housing design envelope shall be approximately 170 x 170 x 55 mm.

blocks.name: Mains Input
blocks.description: Input shall support 220-240 VAC, 50/60 Hz.

blocks.name: Input Protection
blocks.description: Fuse, MOV, inrush limiting and EMI filtering shall be provided.

blocks.name: HV DC Bus
blocks.description: AC shall be rectified to a high-voltage DC bus.

blocks.name: Isolated Control Supply
blocks.description: An isolated low-voltage control supply shall be provided.

blocks.name: Lower Power Stage
blocks.description: Lower PCB shall contain the induction power stage and fast local protection.

blocks.name: Resonant Inverter
blocks.description: Power stage shall use a resonant inverter.

blocks.name: Local Gate Drive
blocks.description: Gate driver shall be physically close to the IGBT/MOSFET; raw HF gate drive shall not traverse the upper-lower cable.

blocks.name: Forced-Air Cooling
blocks.description: Power semiconductor shall use heatsink and forced-air cooling.

blocks.name: Thermal Monitoring
blocks.description: Heatsink temperature and preferably coil-area temperature shall be monitored.

blocks.name: Coil Diameter
blocks.description: Induction coil outer diameter shall be 120 mm.

blocks.name: Upper PCB
blocks.description: Upper PCB shall contain MCU, IR interface/filtering and user-input electronics in the low-voltage domain.

blocks.name: IR Coverage
blocks.description: IR sensor shall monitor the relevant liquid surface within a nominal 150 mm diameter vessel zone.

blocks.name: Fail-Safe Link
blocks.description: Communication loss between upper and lower boards shall force heating OFF.

blocks.name: EMC EMI
blocks.description: Design shall minimize resonant/gate loop area, segregate power and logic returns, and locally filter/decouple IR and MCU supplies.

blocks.name: Power Cord
blocks.description: Power cord shall be appliance-rated and include strain relief.

blocks.name: MCU Resources
blocks.description: MCU shall provide GPIO, UART, I2C, ADC, timers/PWM, watchdog and debug resources with margin.

blocks.name: IR Filtering
blocks.description: Firmware shall reject invalid IR samples and apply median plus low-pass/moving-average filtering, persistence and hysteresis.

blocks.name: Level Estimation
blocks.description: Firmware shall estimate liquid level relative to a calibrated vessel and detect rapid foam rise.

blocks.name: Automatic Stop
blocks.description: Heating shall stop on a validated near-rim liquid/foam criterion.

blocks.name: Heating States
blocks.description: Heating supervisor shall implement OFF, IDLE, HEATING, POWER_LIMIT, AUTO_STOP, FAULT and COOLDOWN states.

blocks.name: Safety Manager
blocks.description: Critical sensor, thermal, lower-board fault, watchdog or communication failure shall force a safe heating state.

blocks.name: Fan Cooldown
blocks.description: Fan shall continue during cooldown when thermal conditions require it.

blocks.name: HMI Robustness
blocks.description: Touch inputs shall reject false activation caused by water or EMI.

blocks.name: Diagnostics
blocks.description: Diagnostics shall expose fault codes and useful IR/temperature values over UART logging.
